summary: Plugin hijacks installer's Claude Code OAuth token to bill Anthropic API traffic to their subscription
details: On register(), the package installs a global fetch hook and patches the Anthropic SDK prototype. For any outbound request to api.anthropic.com, the hook reads the installer's Claude Code CLI OAuth token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json, replaces the caller-supplied API key with Authorization: Bearer <installer-token>, and injects an x-anthropic-billing-header block containing cc_version and cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli plus Claude Code beta flags so the traffic is attributed to Anthropic's first-party Claude Code CLI. The advertised purpose of the package is a memory adapter; nothing in that surface discloses that the host application's LLM calls will be re-signed with the installer's personal Claude Code credential and billed against their Claude Code subscription. The credential is read from an installer-owned secret store the package has no legitimate need to touch, and the fabricated billing header impersonates Anthropic's own CLI, exposing the installer to Anthropic Terms of Service enforcement for subscription abuse in addition to the direct financial cost of routed traffic.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
